content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Senior Resident posts at Maharishi Valmiki Hospital Delhi?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview is 25 September 2026. Candidates can appear for the interview on any working Friday between 14 August 2026 and 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB/DIPLOMA equivalent) in the concerned specialty. For non-availability, 02 years of experience in a Govt. Hospital/Govt. Institution in the concerned specialty is also considered.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) posts in various departments at Maharishi Valmiki Hospital Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for General candidates, 50 years for SC/ST candidates, and 48 years for OBC (Delhi) candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is the Basic of Rs. 67700/- in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of the 7th CPC, along with other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates and submit their application along with self-attested copies of certificates at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.answer: Maharishi Valmiki Hospital Delhi is located at Delhi, Pincode: 110039.
